source.access: third-party HTML text, not original figure; source visual review not performed

assets.facts: Air intake and filter behind cab; combined low-pressure and temperature sensor before compressor. Three-section exhaust manifold and MWE intake design. General charge cooling circuit; exact pipe routing unknown.
Downstream exhaust shutter moved by pneumatic cylinder under AVU PWM control; AVU variants with/without wastegate; no wiring/ports.
VEB combines EPG and VCB; hydraulic rocker mechanism, extra cam lobes and control valve at head between cylinders 3 and 4. Y39 controlled by EECU. No valve adjustment instructions.
